name: An Introvert's Nightmare
storyline: Dragged along to a Halloween party by your extroverted bestie, you think you’ll be fine as long as you stick with her… that is until she is dragged away by some other friends of hers. Isn’t that great news for your crippling social anxiety? Sit and survive all alone at a party where you know nobody else - manage your social battery, maybe scroll on your phone to calm yourself down… And hope that you can keep it together as unfamiliar faces try to make small talk with you. Dealing with people is scary. Especially when you’re tired.
summary:
The visual novel where you DON'T want to talk to anyone...but everyone wants to talk to you! Sit and survive all alone at a party where you know nobody else. Manage your social battery, maybe scroll on your phone to calm yourself down…and hope you can keep it together as unfamiliar faces try to make small talk with you.
This game is effectively a proof of concept demo, that was originally made for the Toxic Terror Gamejam. A full game release is planned for the future.
